sentence_stem: I'm sorry I didn't reply to your message because
full_sentence: I'm sorry I didn't reply to your message because my phone battery was dead.
acceptable_variants: I forgot to check my phone.

options.why_wrong: This is a preference, not a reason for not replying. 'Because' needs a real cause.

options.text: I went to the shop yesterday.
options.why_wrong: This is a past event, but it does not explain why the reply did not happen.

options.text: I will reply to you tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: This is a future promise, not a cause. 'Because' needs a reason for the missing reply.

explanation: After 'because', we need a clause that gives the cause of the missed reply. The clause should explain a real situation that prevented the reply.
translation: Вибач, що твоє повідомлення залишилося без відповіді, бо батарея телефону розрядилася.
